comments.name: Global_Vision
comments.content: This prize money gap is truly significant, reflecting the huge commercialization disparity between tennis and table tennis globally. Tennis has a massive international audience and endorsements, making it a truly global, high-value sport with huge prize money pots. Table tennis, while incredibly popular, especially in Asia, still has a way to go in terms of global marketing and monetization strategies to bridge that financial gap. It's a business, after all. Gotta optimize for global reach, you know? 📈
